content: If you miss a dose of your medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is less than 8 hours before your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Store this medication at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. Do not use it for other conditions unless directed by your doctor. While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as liver function tests, complete blood count, and blood glucose levels) may be required.
